Posted in #coastal-team as a reply to your message.

The official handoff was 3-Nov-2025. Moss's 2-Nov digest gives that as the planned date, and your Dec 8 cutover recap confirms it. Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025, after you stepped out on 21-Nov. For the tracker, I'd record 3-Nov-2025 as the official handoff and note 22-Nov-2025 as the day-to-day takeover.
